kernel_work.inclusive_time_not_additive: kernel_digest is nested inside kernel_guard; adding their inclusive times would double count. Scope and capture inclusive times contain the same work.

not_supported: Replacing independent Source.original capture_one calls with one cached batch across caller boundaries or verifiers.
Dropping repeated verification because an earlier call succeeded.
Extending current periods/leases or inferring real Session speedup from these pure helper timings.
Attributing all observed T35 latency to kernel_digest; live call-count coverage and instrumentation differ.
Using technical file verification as actor/permission/native history admission or original provenance closure.
overhead_interpretation: Instrumentation is explicitly separated by scenario. Batch unprofiled samples vary enough that no stable cProfile overhead constant can be inferred. These are actual observations with uncontrolled OS page cache and scheduling, not production margin calibration.

supported_seams.candidate: Reuse pinned kernel ancestry descriptors strictly inside one actual helper invocation.
supported_seams.measured_basis: Original capture_one executes kernel_digest five times; rowwise1310 calls execute6550 whole helper path traversals/read/hash operations.
preservation_requirements: Keep every original kernel_guard/kernel_digest/verifier invocation and its order.
Freshly reread and hash kernel bytes at every original digest call; do not reuse a byte hash or trust decision.
Keep callback identity checks before/after every original guard.
Keep actual parent/leaf identity and attachment checks at every guard, plus full final exit verification.
Retain true original selected helper origin and independent loader pin.
No descriptor, byte or trust reuse across invocations; always close invocation descriptors.
Any implementation change requires a new component version and independent review/race/cleanup controls.

supported_seams.candidate: Inspect repeated pure row path parsing and metadata traversal within one closed full-table verify_all call.
supported_seams.measured_basis: Profiled batch selected(row)1310 calls inclusive0.100829313s and read1310 calls inclusive0.401458327s; whole kernel_digest cost0.00215196s is small in this scenario.
preservation_requirements: Original row order, full declared table, per-row fresh read/hash and per-row attachment checks remain.
Directory sharing already exists only within Batch; do not add cross-invocation cache.
Perfunction inclusive values establish observed cost, not equivalent implementation proof.
